_comment: Golden test cases — one verified input/output per dataset. Verify after any ETL refresh or logic change. See DATA_INTEGRITY_STANDARDS.md R4.

cases.description: Arlington County, VA — most recent HUD income limits row
cases.query: SELECT fiscal_year, county_name, state_abbr, ami_4person, ami_80pct, ami_50pct, ami_120pct FROM hud_features WHERE county_fips = '51013' ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC LIMIT 1
cases.notes: FY2026 HUD ETL ran 2026-06-27 but did not produce a FY2026 row for this county; FY2025 is the latest. The AMI Qualifier uses GSE (FHFA) as primary for this county — FY2025 HUD is the fallback only. Verify: after next ETL, expected fiscal_year should advance to 2026.

cases.description: Arlington County, VA — FY2026 FHFA AMI (Freddie Mac source, authoritative for HomeReady/Home Possible)
cases.query: SELECT county_fips, ami_fhfa, fiscal_year FROM gse_ami WHERE county_fips = '51013'
cases.notes: This is the figure DU/LPA should match for HomeReady/Home Possible in Arlington VA. 80% limit = $131,280. Verify: after 2026 FHFA release (June 2027), ami_fhfa and fiscal_year should update.

cases.description: Census tract 51013100500 — Upper income, not D&U (4524 26th St N, Arlington VA 22207)
cases.query: SELECT census_tract_geoid, tract_income_level, tract_mfi_pct, distressed_underserved, msa_md, data_year FROM ffiec_census_tracts WHERE census_tract_geoid = '51013100500'
cases.notes: Tract at 184.1% of area MFI — well above the 120% threshold for Upper designation. Not D&U (metro tract; D&U is nonmetro only). End-to-end geocode test: address '4524 26th St N, Arlington VA 22207' → this GEOID via Census Geocoder.

cases.description: Census tract 42127960100 — Middle income + D&U designated (Wayne County, PA)
cases.query: SELECT census_tract_geoid, tract_income_level, distressed_underserved, msa_md, data_year FROM ffiec_census_tracts WHERE census_tract_geoid = '42127960100'
cases.notes: This tract is in a nonmetro county (msa_md=99999). Demonstrates D&U can apply to Middle-income tracts. Also demonstrates the nonmetro MFI state_fips bug: querying ffiec_mfi without state_fips filter for msa_md=99999 may return the wrong state's MFI. county_fips=42127 → state_fips=42 (PA). See DATA_INTEGRITY_STANDARDS.md known issue #2.

cases.query: SELECT msa_md, area_name, mfi_estimate, state_fips, data_year FROM ffiec_mfi WHERE msa_md = '11694' ORDER BY data_year DESC LIMIT 1
cases.notes: 80% × 3-person factor (0.90) × $172,700 = $124,344. This matches the verified ffiecEligibility.ts output for the Arlington VA test address. Verify after 2025 FFIEC flat file refresh: mfi_estimate and data_year should both update.

cases.description: Arlington County, VA — 2024 NRI composite risk
cases.query: SELECT county_fips, county_name, state_abbr, composite_score, risk_label, dominant_hazard, insurance_pressure, insurance_est_low, insurance_est_high FROM fema_risk WHERE county_fips = '51013'
cases.notes: Composite 66.8 with dominant hazard=heat yields insurance_pressure=elevated per the heuristic in etl-fema.mjs:deriveInsurancePressure(). Note: 'Relatively Low' is FEMA's label; 'elevated' is HomeRates' derived insurance pressure category — they are not contradictory (FEMA label is relative to national distribution; HomeRates label reflects the specific hazard type).

cases.description: National baseline conforming limits CY2026 — all standard counties not listed in HIGH_COST_COUNTIES
cases.notes: Source: FHFA FullCountyLoanLimitList2026_HERA-BASED_FINAL_FLAT.xlsx, effective Jan 1, 2026. Ceiling for AK/HI/DC/territories: $1,249,125 (1-unit); HI Kalawao/Maui exception: $1,299,500. Update lib/loanLimitsNational2026.ts and lib/loanLimits2026.ts each November when FHFA publishes.

cases.description: End-to-end: 4524 26th St N Arlington VA, $95k income, 3-person household
cases.notes: Verified 2026-07-03 against staging. income_eligible=true from FFIEC path because $95k < $124,344 (80% of $172,700 × 0.90 HH-3 factor). HomeReady pass because $95k < $131,280 (80% of FHFA $164,100). Geocoder path confirmed active via address_geocode_cache.

cases.description: ami50pct must always be flat 50% of FHFA 4-person AMI regardless of household size
cases.notes: Bug fixed 2026-07-03: was returning $54,240 for HH=2 (amiForHH×0.50 = $108,480×0.50). Route now computes ami50=Math.round(ami4×0.50)=$67,800, same flat base as ami80. HUD stores ami_50pct=$78,500 for Ventura (different median baseline) — intentionally not used. Verify: ami50pct must equal ami4Person×0.50 = $135,600×0.50 = $67,800 regardless of householdSize input.

cases.dataset: FFIEC Estimated Median Family Income — nonmetro state_fips filter
cases.description: Wayne County PA (msa_md=99999) must return PA's MFI ($83,700), not an arbitrary state's
cases.query: SELECT mfi_estimate, state_fips, data_year FROM ffiec_mfi WHERE msa_md='99999' AND state_fips='42' ORDER BY data_year DESC LIMIT 1
cases.notes: Bug fixed 2026-07-03 (F3): mfiForMsaMd() now filters by state_fips when msa_md='99999'. Before fix: Postgres returned Wyoming (state_fips=56, $99,300) — off by $15,600. Fix: county_fips.slice(0,2) passed as stateFips through both FFIEC paths. Verify: after fix, Wayne County PA queries return state_fips='42' row ($83,700), not whichever state Postgres returns first. Previous nonmetro test (ZIP 18447) landed in Lackawanna Co PA (metro, msa_md=42540) and did NOT trigger this bug — this case was added specifically for nonmetro coverage.
